# Sample Homeowners Wording (fictional)

> Written for testing only. This is not a real policy, wording or company document, and contains no customer data.

## Section 1. Property cover

### HO-1.1 Insured property
We cover the dwelling and attached structures shown in the schedule, against direct physical loss or damage
caused by a peril listed in HO-1.3.

### HO-1.2 Special limits
Jewellery, watches and furs are covered up to 2,500 dollars in total for any one loss.

### HO-1.3 Perils insured
Fire, lightning, explosion, riot, storm and flood (where flood is shown as included in the schedule).

## Section 2. Liability cover

### HO-2.1 Personal liability
We cover amounts the insured becomes legally liable to pay for bodily injury or property damage to a third party,
up to the limit shown in the schedule.

### HO-2.2 Exclusions
We do not cover liability arising from the insured's business, from ownership of aircraft, or from intentional acts.

## Section 3. Claims

### HO-3.1 Notice of claim
The insured must tell us within 30 days of becoming aware of a loss, and must not admit liability or settle a claim
without our written consent.
